notes: Budget ceiling: $4k–$5k per month all-in. Track listings, applications and move-in timing in this thread.
prompt: I am Kevin Doud. Help me find and secure a new house to rent within $4,000 to $5,000 a month all-in. Ask me five questions first (areas, bedrooms, move-in date, pets, must-haves). Then give me a search plan with the sites to check daily and saved-search filters, a one-page application packet checklist (ID, proof of income, references, deposit amount to have ready), a short message template to send landlords, and a simple comparison table I can fill in for each listing (address, rent, deposit, commute to the Chatsworth lab, pros, cons, status).
title: House: find and secure a new house within budget — $4,000–$5,000 a month range
